meta.name: ESP32-S31 Korvo Board voice HA controller
meta.description: Voice-controlled wall dashboard for a Home Assistant setup that controls the TRV radiator valves of each room

features.text: Voice control — wake word "Hi ESP", spoken commands in English (on-board ES8389 mic and speaker)
Room thermostat dashboard — on-board RGB LCD shows every room with its current temperature and target temperature
Touch control — GT1151 touch panel selects a room and raises/lowers its target temperature, step 0.5 °C within the TRV's allowed range
Home Assistant integration over MQTT with auto-discovery — each room's thermostat is a climate entity; setpoint changes are forwarded by HA to that room's Zigbee TRV (zigbee2mqtt)
Room temperature comes from Home Assistant room air sensors (never from the device itself)
Shows the 4 smart-heated rooms — bathroom, hallway, office, living room (kitchen and bedroom have no smart TRV and stay off the screen)
Local web page — SoftAP + mDNS onboarding, Wi-Fi/settings page served by the device
Status LED (on-board WS2812 strip) — shows listening / thinking / speaking / offline
